english: Take one tablet with a glass of water.

english: Give your child 5 ml of the syrup.
amharic_ref: ለልጆ ከሽሮፑ 5 ሚሊ ይስጡት።

english: Take two 500 mg tablets.

oromo_ref: Kiniinii 500 mg lama fudhadhu.

english: Take half a tablet in the morning.

english: Put two drops in each eye.

oromo_ref: Ija lamanu keessatti cobsa lama cobisi.

english: Mix one sachet of oral rehydration salts into a litre of clean water.

amharic_ref: አንድ ካፕሱል ይውስዱ።
oromo_ref: Kiniinii tokko fudhadhu.

english: Apply a thin layer of the cream to the area.
amharic_ref: ቦታውን በቀጭኑ በክሬሙ ይቀቡት።
oromo_ref: Naannoo sanaati kirimichaa tiqasi dibi.

english: Take one teaspoon of the medicine.
amharic_ref: ከመድሃኒቱ አንድ የሻይ ማንኪያ ይውስዱ።
oromo_ref: Qorichicha falana shaayii tokko fudhadhu.

english: The usual adult dose is two tablets.
amharic_ref: የተለመደው የአዋቂ ዶዝ ሁለት ኪኒን ነው።
oromo_ref: Safartuun ga'eessotaan barame kiniinii lamadha

english: Give the baby 2.5 ml of the drops.
amharic_ref: ለህጻኑ ከጠብታው 2.5 ሚሊ ይስጡት።
oromo_ref: Daa'imichaaf cobsa mililitaara 2.5 kennf.

english: Use one puff from the inhaler.
amharic_ref: የአተነፋፈስ ማስታገሻውን አንድ ጊዜ ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Inhaalara  hargansuu tokko fayyadami.

english: Take one and a half tablets.
amharic_ref: አንድ ከግማሽ ኪኒኖች ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Kiniinii tokko fi walakkaa fudhadhu.

english: Take one tablet three times a day for five days.
amharic_ref: አንድ ኪኒን በቀን ሶስት ጊዜ ለአምስት ቀናት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaatti si'a sadii kiniinii tokko tokko guyyoota shaniif  fudhadhu.

english: Take this medicine every 8 hours.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት በየስምንት ሰዓቱ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana sa'aa 8 8tiin fudhadhu.

english: Take one capsule once a day for two weeks.
amharic_ref: አንድ ካፕሱል በቀን አንድ ጊዜ ለአምስት ቀናት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Torban lamaaf guyyaatti si'a tokko kiniinii tokko fudhadhu.

english: Take the tablets for 7 days, even if you feel better.
amharic_ref: የመዳን ስሜት ቢሰማዎትም እንኳን ኪኒኑን ለ7 ቀናት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo fayyites, kiniinii sana guyyaa 7f fudhadhu.

english: Take one tablet in the morning and one in the evening.
amharic_ref: አንድ ኪኒን በጠዋት እና አንድ በቀትር ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Ganama fi galgala kiniinii tokko tokko  fudhadu.

english: Use the cream twice a day for 10 days.
amharic_ref: ክሬሙን በቀን ሁለት ጊዜ ለአስር ቀናት ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaatti si'a lama guyyaa 10f debatichaa dibadhu.

english: Take one tablet every other day.
amharic_ref: ከዚህ ቀን ውጭ አንድ ኪኒን ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaa tokko dabarsuun kiniinii tokko fudhadhu.

english: You should take this medicine for three months.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ለሶስት ወራት መውስድ ይኖርቦታል።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana ji'a sadiif fudhachuu qabda.

english: Take one tablet once a week, on the same day each week.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት በተመሳሳይ ቀን በየሳምንቱ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Torbanitti al tokko, guyyaa wal fakkaataati torban torbaniin kiniinii tokko fudhadhu.

english: Wait at least 6 hours between doses.
amharic_ref: በዶዞች መካከል ቢያንስ 6 ሰዓታት ይጠብቁ።
oromo_ref: Fuudhatta  qorichaa gidduutti yoo xiqqaate sa'aa 6 eegi

english: Put the drops in twice a day for 1 week.
amharic_ref: ጠብታዎቹን በቀን ሁለት ጊዜ ለአንድ ሳምንት ይድርጉ።
oromo_ref: Torban 1f guyyaatti si'a lama cobsicha cobisi.

english: Take this medicine every 12 hours for 3 days.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት በየ12 ሰዓታት ለ3 ቀናት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaa 3f sa'aa 12 12tti qoricha kana fudhadhu.

english: Take one tablet at bedtime for 30 days.
amharic_ref: አንድ ኪኒን በመተኛ ሰዓት ላይ ለ30 ቀናት ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Guyyaa 30f yeroo raftutti kiniinii tokko fudhadhu.

english: Do not take this medicine on an empty stomach.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት በባዶ ሆድ እንዳይወስዱ።
oromo_ref: Garaa duwwaatti qoricha kana hin fudhatin.

english: Do not take more than 4 tablets in 24 hours.
amharic_ref: በ24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ ከ4 ኪኒኖች በላይ እንዳይወስዱ።
oromo_ref: Sa'aa 24 keessatti kiniinii 4 ol hin fudhatin.

english: Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት እየወሰዱ አልኮል እንዳይጠጡ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana fudhachaa osoo jirtu alkoolii hin dhugin.

english: Do not give this medicine to children under 5.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ከ5 ዓመት በታች ለሆኑ ህጻናት እንዳይሰጡ።
oromo_ref: Ijoollee waggaa 5 gadi ta'aniif qoricha kana hin kennin.

english: Do not crush or chew the tablets.
amharic_ref: ኪኒኖቹን እንዳይጨፈልቁ ወይም እንዳያኝኩ።
oromo_ref: Kiniinii kana caccabsuu ykn alanfachuu hin qabin.

english: Do not stop taking this medicine without talking to a health worker.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ከጤና ባለሙያ ጋር ሳያነጋገሩ እንዳያቋርጡ።
oromo_ref: Ogeessa fayyaa waliin osoo hin haasa'in qoricha kana fudhachuu dhiisuu hin qabdu.

english: Do not take this medicine if you are pregnant.
amharic_ref: እርጉዝ ከሆኑ ይህን መድሃኒት እንዳይወስዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo ulfa taate qoricha kana hin fudhatin.

english: If you miss a dose, do not take two doses at once.
amharic_ref: ዶዝ ካመለጦት ሁለት ዶዝ በአንድ ጊዜ እንዳይወስዱ።

amharic_ref: የፔኔሲሊን አለርጂክ ካለቦት ይህን መድሃኒት እንዳይጠቀሙ።

english: Do not use this cream on broken skin.
amharic_ref: ይህን ክሬም በተጎዳ ቆዳ ላይ እንዳይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Gogaa madaa'e irratti kirimicha kana hin fayyadamin.

english: Stop taking this medicine and see a doctor if you get a rash.
amharic_ref: ሽፍታ ከታየቦት ይህን መድሃኒት መውሰድ ያቁሙ።
oromo_ref: Yoo shifiin gogaan sitti baa'e qoricha kana fudhachuu dhiisiitii doktoora bira deemi.

english: Do not take this medicine with other products that contain paracetamol.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት በውስጣቸው ፓራሲታሞል ከሚይዙ ምርቶች ጋር እንዳይወስዱ።
oromo_ref: Oomishaalee biroo kan qoricha mata dhukube  qabatan wajjin qoricha kana hin fudhatin.

english: Swallow the tablet whole with water.
amharic_ref: ኪኒኑን ሙሉ ከውሃ ጋር ይዋጡት።
oromo_ref: Kiniinii kana bishaan waliin guutummaatti liqimsi.

english: Apply the cream to the affected area only.
amharic_ref: ክሬሙን በተጎዳው ቦታ ላይ ብቻ ይጠቀሙ።
oromo_ref: Kirimicha naannoo miidhame qofa irratti dibi.

english: Take this medicine with food.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ከምግብ ጋር ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana nyaata waliin fudhadhu.

english: Take this medicine 30 minutes before a meal.
amharic_ref: ይህን መድሃኒት ምግብ ከመብላቶ በፊት 30 ደቂቃ አስቀድመው ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Nyaata dura daqiiqaa 30tti qoricha kana fudhadhu.

english: Take one tablet only if you have a fever.
amharic_ref: ትኩሳት ካሎት ብቻ አንድ ኪኒን ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo ho'iinsa  qabaatte qofa kiniinii tokko fudhadhu.

english: Take one tablet if the pain comes back.
amharic_ref: ህመሙ ተመልሶ ከመጣ አንድ ኪኒን ይውስዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo dhukkubbiin deebi'ee dhufe kiniinii tokko fudhadhu.

english: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
amharic_ref: ዶዝ ካመለጦት ልክ ባስታወሱት ጊዜ ይውሰዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo qoricha dabarsite, akkuma yaadatte fudhadhu.

english: If your fever lasts more than 3 days, go to the clinic.
amharic_ref: ትኩሳቱ ከ3ቀን በላይ ከቆየ ወደ ክሊኒክ ይሂዱ።
oromo_ref: Yoo ho'iinsikee guyyaa 3 ol ture, kilinika deemi.

english: Shake the bottle well before use.
amharic_ref: ከመጠቀሞ በፊት ጠርሙዙን በደንብ ያወዛውዙ።
oromo_ref: Fayyadamuu dura qaruuricha sirriitti hurgufi.

english: This ointment is for use on the skin only.
amharic_ref: ቅባቱ ለቆዳ ጥቅም ብቻ ነው የሚውልው።
oromo_ref: Dibanni kun gogaa qofa irratti kan fayyadamuudha.

english: Put the drops in your left eye only.
amharic_ref: ጠብታዎቹን በግራ አይኖት ላይ ብቻ ያድርጉ።
oromo_ref: Cobsa kana ija kee bitaa qofa irratti cobisi.

english: Drink plenty of water while taking this medicine.
amharic_ref: መድሃኒቱን በሚወስዱበት ጊዜ ብዙ ውሃ ይጠጡ።
oromo_ref: Qoricha kana fudhachaa osoo jirtu bishaan baay'ee dhugi.

english: Take one spoonful of the syrup.
amharic_ref: ከሽሮፑ አንድ የሾርባ ማንኪያ ይዉሰዱ።

english: Give five milliliters of the syrup.
amharic_ref: አምስት ሚሊሊትር ሽሮፕ ስጡ (አስወስዱ)።

english: Use two puffs of the inhaler.
amharic_ref: የአተነፋፈስ ማስታገሻውን (ኢንሂለር) ሁለት ጊዜ  ይጠቀሙ።

english: Take 500 mg per dose.
amharic_ref: በአንድ ጊዜ 500 ሚሊ ግራም ይውሰዱ።

english: Dissolve one sachet in a glass of water.
amharic_ref: አንድ እሽግ (ፓኬት) መድኃኒት በአንድ ብርጭቆ ውሃ በጥብጠው ይጠጡ።

english: Take two capsules with water.
amharic_ref: ሁለት ካፕሱል በውሃ ይዋጡ።

english: Place one tablet under the tongue.
amharic_ref: አንድ እንክብል ከምላስዎ ስር ያድርጉ።

english: Take three tablets at once.
amharic_ref: ሦስት እንክብሎችን በአንድ ጊዜ ይዋጡ።

english: Take two tablets at a time.
amharic_ref: በአንድ ጊዜ ሁለት እንክብሎችን ይዋጡ።

english: Take one tablet by mouth.
amharic_ref: አንድ እንክብል በአፍ ይዋጡ።

english: Apply a thin layer of the cream to the skin.
amharic_ref: ክሬሙን ቆዳዎ ላይ በስሱ ይቀቡ።

english: Give the child half a tablet.
amharic_ref: ለልጁ ግማሽ ክኒን ይስጡት።

english: Use one drop in each eye.
amharic_ref: በእያንዳንዱ ዓይን ውስጥ አንድ አንድ ጠብታ ያድርጉ።

english: Take one tablet in the morning and one at night.
amharic_ref: ጠዋት አንድ እንክብል፣ ማታ አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Use the eye drops for three days only.
amharic_ref: የዓይን ጠብታውን ለሦስት ቀናት ብቻ ይጠቀሙ።

english: Use the cream for seven days.
amharic_ref: ክሬሙን ለሰባት ቀናት ይቀቡ።

english: Take this medicine once a week.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት በሳምንት አንድ ጊዜ ይውሰዱ።

english: Take the medicine every six hours.
amharic_ref: መድኃኒቱን በየስድስት ሰዓቱ ይውሰዱ።

english: Take one tablet daily for three months.
amharic_ref: ለሦስት ወራት በየቀኑ አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Take the tablets for two weeks.
amharic_ref: እንክብሎቹን ለሁለት ሳምንታት ይዋጡ።

english: Take this medicine for five days.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ለአምስት ቀናት ይውሰዱ።

english: Take one tablet every 12 hours.
amharic_ref: በየ12 ሰዓቱ አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Take one tablet four times a day.
amharic_ref: በቀን አራት ጊዜ አንድ አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Take one tablet once daily.
amharic_ref: በቀን አንድ ጊዜ አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Take one tablet before bedtime.
amharic_ref: ከመተኛትዎ በፊት አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Finish all the tablets even if you feel better.
amharic_ref: ቢሻልዎትም እንኳ እንክብሎቹን በሙሉ ይጨርሱ።

english: Take one tablet before meals three times daily.
amharic_ref: በቀን ሦስት ጊዜ ከምግብ በፊት አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Continue treatment for ten days.
amharic_ref: ሕክምናውን ለአሥር ቀናት ይቀጥሉ።

english: Take one capsule every eight hours.
amharic_ref: በየስምንት ሰዓቱ አንድ ካፕሱል ይዋጡ።

english: Take one tablet twice daily.
amharic_ref: በቀን ሁለት ጊዜ አንድ አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Take this medicine for 14 days.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ለ14 ቀናት ይውሰዱ።

english: Take the medicine for one month.
amharic_ref: መድኃኒቱን ለአንድ ወር ይውሰዱ።

english: Stop taking this medicine after six days.
amharic_ref: ከስድስት ቀናት በኋላ ይህንን መድኃኒት መውሰድ ያቁሙ።

english: Apply the cream twice a day.
amharic_ref: ክሬሙን በቀን ሁለት ጊዜ ይቀቡ።

english: Take one tablet three times a day.
amharic_ref: በቀን ሦስት ጊዜ አንድ አንድ እንክብል ይዋጡ።

english: Take the medicine until the bottle is empty.
amharic_ref: ብልቃጡ ውስጥ ያለው መድኃኒት እስኪያልቅ ድረስ ይውሰዱ።

english: Take this medicine for five weeks.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ለአምስት ሳምንታት ይውሰዱ።

english: Keep this medicine out of reach of children.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ሕፃናት በማይደርሱበት ቦታ ያስቀምጡ።

english: Do not use this medicine after the expiry date.
amharic_ref: የመጠቀሚያ ጊዜው ካለፈበት በኋላ ይህንን መድኃኒት አይጠቀሙ።

english: Do not stop taking this medicine suddenly.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት በድንገት መውሰድ አያቁሙ።

english: Take this medicine one hour before meals.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ከምግብ አንድ ሰዓት በፊት ይውሰዱ።

english: Do not share this medicine with other people.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ለሌሎች ሰዎች አይስጡ።

english: Do not use this medicine for longer than 7 days.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ከ7 ቀናት በላይ አይጠቀሙ።

english: Do not take this medicine if you have kidney problems.
amharic_ref: የኩላሊት ችግር ካለብዎት ይህንን መድኃኒት አይውሰዱ።

english: Do not drive or use machines if you feel sleepy.
amharic_ref: እንቅልፍ እንቅልፍ የሚልዎት ከሆነ መኪና አያሽከርክሩ ወይም ማሽኖችን አይጠቀሙ።

english: Do not store this medicine in a hot place.
amharic_ref: ይህንን መድኃኒት ሙቀት ባለበት ቦታ አያስቀምጡ።

english: Rinse your mouth with water after using the inhaler.
amharic_ref: ኢንሄለሩን (መሳቢያውን) ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ አፍዎን በውሃ ይጉመጥመጡ።

english: Dissolve the tablet in water before drinking.
amharic_ref: ከመጠጣትዎ በፊት እንክብሉን በውሃ ውስጥ ይበጥብጡት።

english: Go to the clinic at once if you feel dizzy or have trouble breathing.
amharic_ref: ማዞር ከተሰማዎት ወይም የመተንፈስ ችግር ካጋጠምዎት ወዲያውኑ ወደ ክሊኒክ ይሂዱ።

english: Wash your hands before applying the cream.
amharic_ref: ክሬሙን ከመቀባትዎ በፊት እጅዎን ይታጠቡ።
